summary: Frontend-only regression test for CoFound auth navigation bug fix on mobile viewport (390x844). All 4 critical tests PASSED: (1) Registration → redirects to Onboarding screen, (2) Login → redirects to Onboarding/Discover based on user state, (3) Full flow Register → Onboarding form fill → Discover tab works end-to-end, (4) Google Sign-In redirects to auth.emergentagent.com correctly. router.replace('/') fix confirmed working after signUp/signIn success. Network requests verified: POST /api/auth/register 200, POST /api/auth/login 200, GET /api/auth/me 200, POST /api/onboarding/complete 200.

issues: Console warnings: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated (use boxShadow); props.pointerEvents is deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Non-blocking but should be cleaned up.

react_native_issues.issue: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents. Reference: react-native-web deprecation warning triggered on button interactions across auth screens.
'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Reference: appears on initial app render for React Native Web (RN 0.75+ deprecation).

action_items: No functional action items — auth navigation fix verified working.
Optional cleanup: Migrate deprecated 'shadow*' styles to 'boxShadow' and 'pointerEvents' prop to style.pointerEvents to remove console warnings (react-native-web deprecations).
critical_code_review_comments: register.tsx line 31,36: Still uses Alert.alert (won't show on web) for client-side validation errors (missing fields, password<6). Only the API-error branch uses window.alert on web. Consider unifying to platform-aware alerts for validation too.
login.tsx line 30: Same issue — Alert.alert for empty-fields validation won't fire on web.
AuthContext.checkExistingSession: setLoading(false) is inside finally, correct. But if getMe fails after storing token from prior session, token is removed — good.
Success rate observation: full auth + onboarding + discover flow works cleanly with real backend integration.
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral test users during registration flow (bugfix_<ts>@test.com, logintest_<ts>@test.com, onboard_<ts>@test.com). No cleanup performed — these are test-only accounts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth navigation bug fix verified end-to-end on mobile web preview. Register → Onboarding → Discover works. Login → routes correctly based on onboarding_completed flag. Google Sign-In redirects to https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=<origin>/ as expected. Note: React Native TextInput with multiline=true renders as <textarea> in web; use textarea[placeholder=...] selector for Skills/Objectives/Bio fields on the onboarding screen.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: after successful register/login API call (200 OK), user remained on the auth screen because AuthContext only updated user state but never triggered navigation. Fix (verified): register.tsx and login.tsx now call router.replace('/') after signUp/signIn success — the index.tsx redirects based on user + onboarding_completed. Additionally, Alert.alert was replaced with window.alert on web for error branches. All confirmed working via Playwright mobile viewport testing.
